description: This Kotlin class defines a custom UI component 'CategorySectionView' for an Android shopping app. It manages the display of product categories including the header, a list of product previews, and handles loading/error states.

classes.name: CategorySectionView
classes.description: Custom Android view for displaying a product category section, including header, product list, and state handling.

methods.name: bindHeader
methods.description: Sets the category title and icon, and assigns a click handler for 'See All' button.

methods.name: showLoading
methods.description: Displays or hides a loading indicator.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Displays an error message or hides it based on parameters.

methods.name: submitItems
methods.description: Submits a list of products to the adapter for display and shows an empty hint if list is empty.
